service.description: Receive a customer return shipment's lines: for each return item the quantity that arrived, accepted and rejected (quarantined) alike, received as stock (AssetReceipt) on the item's shipment source, added to ReturnItem.receivedQuantity. It never changes returnQuantity and processes no response, so a second box, or units rejected at the dock, can still be received and credited against the authorization by settle#Return. An item reaches ReturnReceived (ReturnManResp for a manual response) when its received quantity equals the authorized quantity, the return when every item is handled, and the shipment ShipDelivered when every source is handled. Refuses more than was authorized (RECEIPT_EXCEEDS_RETURN), an item not on the shipment, a closed item, a shipment that is not a customer return, and an organization that does not settle returns separately (RETURN_SETTLEMENT_OFF: Mantle receives its returns when the shipment is delivered). Needs STOCK_RECEIVE in the receiving organization. With an operationKey it is the Warehouse return receipt (impl-warehouse P14, ReturnStock.js), on the posting guard: a retry answers the first receipt; the facility is one of the user's organizations' (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE); the tracking policy's lot and serial rules (LOT_REQUIRED, SERIAL_COUNT_MISMATCH, SERIAL_DUPLICATE; a serialized line is received a unit at a time); a rejection needs a reason (REASON_REQUIRED); the accepted stock goes as AstQuarantine to a quarantine location (the receiver's, the operation policy's, else the facility's first; LOCATION_NOT_QUARANTINE, LOCATION_REQUIRED, LOCATION_CLOSED), and an inspection of each accepted receipt is created in the same operation (source QisReturn, context QicReturn): its disposition releases the stock; a closed fiscal period today is PERIOD_CLOSED.

service.description: Labels (design Ship): buy a packed shipment's package labels (or one package's; with returnLabels Y the return labels) through its shipping gateway, choosing the carrier and method first when given. Requesting a label ships nothing. Each package's request is recorded and committed first (record#ShippingGatewayRequests: the shipment locked, its checks, a ShippingGatewayRequest), then sent with no transaction of ours open, each package in a transaction of its own (CarrierServices.request#ShipmentLabels with the request id as its reference), so a label one package gets is never rolled back by another's failure. A refusal (LABEL_REFUSED, ADDRESS_INVALID) fails that package; a timeout or an error with no answer leaves it Unknown, and the next request asks the gateway first (its find#ShippingLabels) and buys no second label when the first exists. A package with a label is answered at once (LABEL_EXISTS); a refunded label is replaced. The operation is stored only when every package has an answer. Requires SHIPMENT_SHIP; refuses a shipment outside the user's facilities (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), not packed (SHIPMENT_NOT_PACKED) or shipped (SHIPMENT_SHIPPED), a method the carrier lacks (METHOD_INVALID), a method no gateway buys labels for (NO_GATEWAY: record the tracking by hand), a package with no weight (WEIGHT_REQUIRED) or not on the shipment (PACKAGE_UNAVAILABLE).
